text:
julia: Scheduling a partial rollout for ff `adaptive_cache_v2` at 22:00 UTC. Ramp: 0.3% -> 1.5% -> 7% with 12m holds. Pin param `cache_policy=v2.0.1` for cohorts. Exclude internal traffic.
kiran: Copy. I'll watch autoscaler and memory pressure.
julia: @leo you own quality checks for holdpoints 1 and 2. Run the smoke eval deck and token-diff.
leo: On it. Also please enable `kv_prefill=true` for cohorts to reduce cold miss noise.
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout 4120001111. Commands: `ffctl enable adaptive_cache_v2 --cohort=keyed:0.3% --param cache_policy=v2.0.1 --meta kv_prefill=true` and `monctl watch p95,errors,eval_delta --window=12m`. Posting 3m updates.
deploy-bot: (3m) 0.3% live. p95 +4%, errors 0.01%, eval_delta +0.1% 1proceeding to 1.5% in 2m.
kiran: Infra steady. No GC spikes.
leo: First smoke pass neutral. Proceed.
deploy-bot: 1.5% enabled. Holding.
deploy-bot: (hold) eval_delta -0.9% at 1.5%  holding and paging owners.
julia: Hold. Do not progress. Leo, paste failing examples to #release-rollback.
leo: Posted prompts showing formatting regression on list outputs. Possible tokenizer newline handling.
kiran: Memory looks fine. This seems quality-specific. Suggest reduce cohort to 0.8% and keep kv_prefill while we hotfix. Partial reduction instead of full rollback.
julia: Agreed. @deploy-bot reduce cohort to 0.8% and keep flag enabled for keyed cohorts only.
deploy-bot: Cohort reduced to 0.8%. Continuing monitor.
deploy-bot: (20m) metrics stable: p95 +6% errors 0.03% eval_delta -0.3%  holding at 0.8%.
julia: We'll cut a patch for tokenizer handling and re-run tomorrow morning. Logging summary to #release-logs and creating retro item to add token-table checksum preflight to block ramps past 5%.
